body:
Worker trap (Termal::BarA2, 2026-10-30 about 01:01Z; my own miss on w-e1aa5b230565, diagnosed by Fable2 #1177).

WHAT HAPPENED
- An Engram handoff offer made with to="Termal::Merger2" (the display name) could not be accepted.
- Merger2's accept was refused with "ambient work has no live incoming handoff offer", even with the item focused.
- The handoff tool's `to` takes any string and validates nothing: it accepted the display name silently.

FIX
1. Cancel the bad offer: handoff action=cancel, reason.
2. Re-offer with to="session-14549", the recipient's TermAl SESSION ID. Merger2 then accepted, after selecting the item's focus.

RULE
Address handoff offers to the recipient's session id, never its display name. Pass ttl_seconds for a long-lived offer, because the default expiry is short (it is capped at your claim expiry).

ALSO
- A live offer blocks your own holder notes on that item, so note before offering.
- Cancel and offer both move your focus to that item; renew your other claim afterwards to restore focus.
